data.narrative:
Trilobio is a seed-stage biotech company founded by Roya Amini-Naieni and Maximilian Schommer that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparative universe of 3 public peers (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private companies in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Given data constraints, only the stage-progression method was applicable. Using total capital raised as a proxy for post-money value at seed, the $11M base applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $28M. Peer-median triangulation could not be applied due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables in the narrow peer set; while 8 biotech peers exist, none meet minimum clustering thresholds. Public-comp anchoring via P/S multiples (sector median 5.6x across the 3 public tickers) could not proceed without Trilobio's disclosed revenue.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, centered at $28M. The reliance on a single methodological input—stage-progression mechanics—represents the primary uncertainty. A more granular range would require either comparable revenue or recurring-revenue metrics from similarly-positioned seed-stage biotech firms, or direct lead investor pricing data from the most recent round.
